nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn toàn bộ hàng đầu tiên của bảng.  2) Table Layout > Merge Cells.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the entire first row of the table.  2) Table Layout > Merge Cells.

cham.de_bai: In the “Digital Resources” section, merge the cells in the first table row.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Đổi font của tiêu đề “Rules and Contact” thành Century Gothic, cỡ 24 pt.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Change the font of the heading “Rules and Contact” to Century Gothic, 24 pt.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn tiêu đề.  2) Home > Font: Century Gothic; Font Size: 24.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the heading.  2) Home > Font: Century Gothic; Font Size: 24.

cham.de_bai: Change the font of the heading “Rules and Contact” to Century Gothic, 24 pt.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Xóa nền của ảnh trong mục “Borrowing Books”. Giữ vùng xóa mặc định mà Word đánh dấu.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Remove the background from the picture in the “Borrowing Books” section. Accept the default area that Word marks for removal.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn ảnh.  2) Picture Format > Remove Background.  3) Background Removal > Keep Changes.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the picture.  2) Picture Format > Remove Background.  3) Background Removal > Keep Changes.

cham.de_bai: Remove the background from the picture in the “Borrowing Books” section. Accept the default area that Word marks for removal.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Events for Children”, đặt khoảng cách trước hai đoạn văn sau tiêu đề là 6 pt và khoảng cách sau là 12 pt.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Events for Children” section, set the spacing before the two paragraphs after the heading to 6 pt and the spacing after to 12 pt.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Chọn hai đoạn văn.  2) Layout > Spacing Before: 6 pt; After: 12 pt.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Select the two paragraphs.  2) Layout > Spacing Before: 6 pt; After: 12 pt.

cham.de_bai: In the “Events for Children” section, set the spacing before the two paragraphs after the heading to 6 pt and the spacing after to 12 pt.

du_an.mo_ta: Mở file De04_P7_Energy_Expert.docx và làm lần lượt các yêu cầu bên dưới. File phụ (ảnh, dữ liệu, 3D Models) nằm cùng thư mục bài làm.
du_an.mo_ta_en: Open De04_P7_Energy_Expert.docx and complete the tasks below in order. Extra files (pictures, data, 3D Models) are in the same work folder.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Trong mục “Solar Projects”, bên trong cặp ngoặc sau chữ “see”, chèn tham chiếu chéo (cross-reference) tới Table 1. Chỉ hiển thị nhãn và số.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: In the “Solar Projects” section, inside the parentheses after the text “see”, insert a cross-reference to Table 1. Display only the label and number.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Đặt con trỏ sau chữ "see " trong ngoặc.  2) References > Cross-reference.  3) Reference type: Table; Insert reference to: Only label and number; chọn Table 1 > Insert > Close.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Put the cursor after "see " inside the parentheses.  2) References > Cross-reference.  3) Reference type: Table; Insert reference to: Only label and number; choose Table 1 > Insert > Close.

cham.de_bai: In the “Solar Projects” section, inside the parentheses after the text “see”, insert a cross-reference to Table 1. Display only the label and number.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Bắt đầu trộn thư (mail merge) kiểu Letters. Dùng workbook Recipients_Energy.xlsx trong thư mục Files làm danh sách người nhận. Trong đoạn bắt đầu bằng “Dear”, chèn trường trộn First_Name giữa chữ “Dear” và dấu phẩy.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Start a Letters mail merge. Use the Recipients_Energy.xlsx workbook in the Files folder as the recipient list. In the paragraph that starts with “Dear”, insert the First_Name merge field between the word “Dear” and the comma.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Mailings > Start Mail Merge > Letters.  2) Select Recipients > Use an Existing List > chọn Recipients_Energy.xlsx > sheet Recipients$ > OK.  3) Đặt con trỏ giữa "Dear " và dấu phẩy > Insert Merge Field > First_Name.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Mailings > Start Mail Merge > Letters.  2) Select Recipients > Use an Existing List > choose Recipients_Energy.xlsx > sheet Recipients$ > OK.  3) Put the cursor between "Dear " and the comma > Insert Merge Field > First_Name.

cham.de_bai: Start a Letters mail merge. Use the Recipients_Energy.xlsx workbook in the Files folder as the recipient list. In the paragraph that starts with “Dear”, insert the First_Name merge field between the word “Dear” and the comma.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Thêm số dòng (line numbers) cho tài liệu, đánh lại từ đầu ở mỗi trang.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Add line numbers to the document that restart on each page.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: Layout > Line Numbers > Restart Each Page.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: Layout > Line Numbers > Restart Each Page.

cham.de_bai: Add line numbers to the document that restart on each page.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Tìm mọi đoạn chữ có màu Dark Red và đổi sang màu Purple.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Find all text that is formatted with the Dark Red font color and change the font color to Purple.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) Home > Replace > More >> > Find what: để trống > Format > Font > Font color: Dark Red (Standard Colors) > OK.  2) Replace with: để trống > Format > Font > Font color: Purple > OK > Replace All.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) Home > Replace > More >> > Find what: leave empty > Format > Font > Font color: Dark Red (Standard Colors) > OK.  2) Replace with: leave empty > Format > Font > Font color: Purple > OK > Replace All.

cham.de_bai: Find all text that is formatted with the Dark Red font color and change the font color to Purple.

nhiem_vu.yeu_cau: Ghi macro tên “QuickStyle” lưu chỉ trong tài liệu này, macro áp dụng style Heading 2 cho đoạn văn đang chọn. Lưu tài liệu dạng Word Macro-Enabled Document vào thư mục Documents, giữ nguyên tên file.
nhiem_vu.yeu_cau_en: Record a macro named “QuickStyle” that is stored in this document only and applies the Heading 2 style to the selected paragraph. Save the document as a Word Macro-Enabled Document in the Documents folder with the same file name.
nhiem_vu.goi_y: 1) View > Macros > Record Macro.  2) Macro name: QuickStyle; Store macro in: tên tài liệu hiện tại (không chọn All Documents) > OK.  3) Home > Styles > Heading 2.  4) View > Macros > Stop Recording.  5) File > Save As > Documents > Save as type: Word Macro-Enabled Document (*.docm) > Save.
nhiem_vu.goi_y_en: 1) View > Macros > Record Macro.  2) Macro name: QuickStyle; Store macro in: the current document name (not All Documents) > OK.  3) Home > Styles > Heading 2.  4) View > Macros > Stop Recording.  5) File > Save As > Documents > Save as type: Word Macro-Enabled Document (*.docm) > Save.

cham.de_bai: Record a macro named “QuickStyle” that is stored in this document only and applies the Heading 2 style to the selected paragraph. Save the document as a Word Macro-Enabled Document in the Documents folder with the same file name.
